# Feluda

> Feluda is Puku's AI code reviewer and agentic pentester. It reviews every pull request on GitHub and GitLab — reading the diff, its callers and production evidence — and posts one evidence-backed comment with a confidence score and a committable fix. Feluda Attack runs AI agents against your staging app, proves what is exploitable, and drafts the fix. Feluda is included with Puku Team and Enterprise; it is not sold separately.

## Product
- [Review](https://feluda.puku.sh/review): PR summaries, ranked findings, confidence score (out of 5), inline fixes, analytics. GitHub and GitLab.
- [Attack](https://feluda.puku.sh/attack): 402 agents per assessment; targets: web, API, Android, MCP, LLM; SOC 2 / ISO-ready reports; daily attack-surface monitoring.
- [How it works](https://feluda.puku.sh/how-it-works): Observe → Investigate → Resolve.
- [Pricing](https://feluda.puku.sh/pricing): Included in Puku Team and Enterprise; runs draw from the plan's monthly requests and pause at 90%.
